verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his poison and Parrrley from 1-5; you win if you pull the wave, hit 6, and he's still in auto range.

brief.thesis: This is a farming race, not a fight: Gangplank wants to poke with Q (Parrrley) and his Grog-Soaked Blade poison while you're stuck in auto range, but Nasus's Q (Siphoning Strike) only needs you in melee for a half-second, not a sustained trade. The matchup sits at 50.1% over 2082 games because both champions are actually doing the same thing — denying the other's stacks/gold — and whoever controls wave position wins that war.

tell.watch: His Parrrley cooldown and your Q stacks

theirWindow.what: Gangplank can land free Q (Parrrley, 5s cooldown, 625 range) and auto-poison stacks without ever entering your Q range (255). Walking up to last-hit minions here just feeds him free damage and Grog-Soaked Blade stacks.

yourWindow.what: Once you have R (Fury of the Sands), engaging inside 400 range turns the fight: your health pool and attack range jump and you start draining his max health into bonus damage. He has no hard CC to stop this, only W (Remove Scurvy) to cleanse and heal — bait that cleanse first if you can, then commit.

start.why: Picked in 72.2% of games (50.2% win rate over 1871 games) because it directly answers his poke pattern — the flat damage reduction against his Parrrley and auto-poison matters more than the mana sustain of Doran's Ring here.

boots.why: Run in 39.8% of games at 49.8% win rate; the physical damage reduction against his stacked autos and Q poke keeps your early trades survivable while you're still only half-stacked on Q.

core.why: Core in the 15.2%-pickrate build (58.3% win rate over 240 games) — the damage and tempo let you actually punish him once you're stacked instead of just farming.

Completes the 58.3%-winrate path — your Soul Eater lifesteal and this item's healing amp turn stacked Q trades into real sustain against his poison.

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the 49.8%-pickrate page because the sustain from Fleet lets you contest cs and farm Q stacks through his poke without losing the wave.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost sees the highest win rate in this matchup (54.2% over the 24.1% of games that run it) — Ghost lets you close the gap on a kiting Gangplank once R is up, which matters more here than the wave-reset value of Teleport.

playing.title: Pull the wave toward your tower
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this lane is to pull and farm with Q rather than stand and trade. Pulling the wave shortens the distance he needs to walk to poke you and lets your tower punish his Parrrley engages.

playing.title: Don't walk up for last hits early
playing.detail: From levels 1-5 his Q (Parrrley, 5s cooldown) and Grog-Soaked Blade poison punish you for approaching minions. Let stacks you can't safely get go rather than eating free poke.

playing.title: Count his Remove Scurvy
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy, 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown) clears CC and heals him. If you land Wither or any slow right after he's used it, he has no answer until it's back up.

playing.title: All-in only inside 400 range post-6
playing.detail: R (Fury of the Sands, 400 range, 120s cooldown) only drains and buffs you while he's close. Don't pop it to chase — walk him down or wait for him to engage first.

playing.title: Respect his ultimate on objectives
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage has 20000 range and can hit you anywhere on the map during drakes or herald. Don't stand still in the damage zone when his R is up — check his ult timer before committing to a fight near the river.

playing.title: Wither before he can kite
playing.detail: W (Wither, 700 range, 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown) decelerates his move and attack speed. Land it the moment he commits to a trade so he can't walk-away poke you with Parrrley while kiting.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live op.gg games on the current patch (16.19.1); the matchup reading — windows, trade patterns, and why they happen — is our own tactical analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from Gangplank to avoid being hit by his Grasp of the Undying + (Q) and (P) basic attacks. Pull lane and farm with [Q] to gain stacks, while looking for an opportunity post-level 6
